projects.title: Nahtadi
projects.tagline: Prayer times and Qibla for iOS. Privacy-first and fully offline, built in Swift and SwiftUI.
projects.description: Native iOS application that calculates the five daily Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) and provides the Qibla direction. Built with Swift and SwiftUI. Features multiple calculation methods, Hijri calendar, prayer notifications, and offline capability.
projects.imageAlt: Nahtadi's mihrab-arch mark in teal-green on a dark green gradient

projects.title: Brent's Method on CUDA
projects.tagline: The first CUDA implementation of Brent's root-finding method. One solver per GPU thread with bit-identical fp64 results.
projects.description: First CUDA implementation of Brent's root-finding method using batch/ensemble parallelism: one independent Brent's instance per GPU thread. Delivers a 35.31× kernel and 8.79× end-to-end speedup over a single-threaded CPU baseline on an NVIDIA RTX 3080, with CPU/GPU bit-identical fp64 results validated to <1e-10 against a Python ground-truth reference across Python, C++, and CUDA. M.S. graduate project.
projects.imageAlt: Glossy green circuit-board icon of a microprocessor chip labeled CUDA, representing GPU-accelerated root-finding

projects.title: NewGame+
projects.tagline: A hybrid Python and Prolog recommender that picks your next game from the ones you already love.
projects.description: Hybrid Python/Prolog recommendation system that suggests video games based on your gaming history. Uses logic-based reasoning to match games by genre, platform, and rating similarity. Integrates with IGDB API for real game data and leverages Prolog's pattern-matching for fast recommendation queries.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of a game joystick beside a plus symbol, representing the NewGame+ recommendation system

projects.title: Mini Compiler
projects.tagline: A table-driven LL(1) compiler that turns Pascal-like source into executable Python. 78 tests, zero dependencies.
projects.description: Production-quality compiler that transforms programs written in a Pascal-like language into executable Python code. Features a table-driven LL(1) predictive parser, semantic analysis with variable tracking, and AST-based code generation. Includes 78 comprehensive tests with 71% coverage, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and complete type hints. Originally a CPSC 323 course project, significantly enhanced with modular architecture, professional testing infrastructure, and zero external dependencies.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of a terminal prompt arrow and cursor, representing the Mini Compiler's code transformation

projects.title: Prayer-Time Algorithm Library
projects.tagline: The zero-dependency Python library behind Nahtadi. Astronomical algorithms with more than eight calculation methods.
projects.description: Zero-dependency, pure-Python scientific-computing library (the engine behind Nahtadi) for calculating Muslim prayer times and Qibla direction from astronomical algorithms (Julian Day, spherical trigonometry, high-latitude adjustments) across 8+ calculation methods. 105 unit tests at 90%+ coverage with GitHub Actions CI.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of a minaret clock tower with a crescent moon, representing the Islamic Prayer Time algorithm library

projects.title: Radar Plotting Trainer
projects.tagline: A maneuvering board that grades your plot, from two radar observations to the maneuver that opens the CPA.
projects.description: A trainer for maneuvering board problems, rebuilt from a Python prototype as a four-package TypeScript monorepo in 12 days. Enter two radar observations, own ship's course and speed, and a required CPA; it returns the contact's true course and speed, the closest point of approach and time to it, and the course or speed change that opens the CPA to the distance required. Graded in CI against two independent answer keys.
projects.imageAlt: White and orange drafting dividers standing on a dark blue radar plotting dial with cyan bearing ticks and range rings

projects.title: Cycloidal Drive Creator
projects.tagline: Generates parametric equations for cycloidal drive rotors that import straight into SolidWorks.
projects.description: Python application that generates parametric equations for cycloidal drive rotors (mechanical speed reducers). Creates rotor profiles that can be directly imported into SolidWorks CAD software via "Equation Driven Curve" feature.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of a layered mechanical gear assembly, representing the Cycloidal Drive Creator's parametric rotor profiles

projects.title: Image Watermark Remover
projects.tagline: A Pix2Pix GAN in PyTorch that removes watermarks, trained on roughly 16,700 images.
projects.description: Machine learning project implementing a Pix2Pix generative adversarial network using PyTorch to automatically eliminate watermarks from digital images. Trained on ~16,700 watermarked images from Unsplash dataset.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of an eraser removing a mark, representing the PyTorch-based watermark remover

projects.title: CG Pilot Training Tracker
projects.tagline: A training-data report adopted at every Coast Guard air station. Over a week of compiling became three minutes.
projects.description: A reporting tool for Coast Guard aviation training currency, built in Python and VBA. It consolidates three exports into one graded sheet: nine qualification currencies and eight recency counters per pilot, each colour-graded against its own interval. Compiling the report went from over a week to three minutes, and building the flight schedule on top of it went from six weeks to two days. Adopted at every U.S. Coast Guard air station and still in daily use. Unpaid volunteer work.
projects.stats: Report in 3 minutes • fleetwide • Auxiliary Achievement Medal
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a Coast Guard helicopter flying over ocean waves at sunset, representing the Pilot Training Tracker

projects.title: CG Helicopter Inventory
projects.tagline: An inventory system for helicopter maintenance, in production in San Diego. Part searches are 85 percent faster.
projects.description: Efficient inventory system and database to enhance Coast Guard helicopter maintenance operations. Resulted in 85% reduction in search time. Currently in operation at Coast Guard Air Station San Diego.
projects.stats: In production at USCG San Diego
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of a warehouse shelf holding labeled storage boxes, representing the Helicopter Inventory System

projects.title: ASL Letter Detector
projects.tagline: Real-time ASL letter detection with a retrained YOLOv5 model. A practice tool for students.
projects.description: Lightweight Python app that detects ASL letters from images or video to help students practice hand positions. Uses a retrained YOLOv5 model for real-time detection.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of a raised fist forming the ASL letter S inside a camera viewfinder frame

projects.title: Wildfire Likelihood Predictor
projects.tagline: A TensorFlow model that predicts California wildfire likelihood from weather and historical data.
projects.description: Predictive model to determine the likelihood of California wildfires based on weather and historical data. Uses TensorFlow for model training and API for data retrieval.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of pine trees silhouetted inside a flame, representing the California Wildfire Likelihood Predictor

projects.title: Reddit NLP Classifier
projects.tagline: Which subreddit said it? Naive Bayes over CountVectorizer at 76.8 percent test accuracy.
projects.description: Natural language processing project that predicts subreddit origins by analyzing language patterns in Pixar and DreamWorks fan communities. Built with scikit-learn using CountVectorizer and Multinomial Naive Bayes, achieving 76.82% test accuracy on scraped Reddit comments.
projects.imageAlt: Stylized icon of overlapping speech bubbles labeled NLP, representing the Reddit NLP Classifier

projects.title: On-Device LLM Summarizer
projects.tagline: A 1.5B model fine-tuned, quantized to 4-bit, and running entirely on an iPhone Apple ruled out for on-device AI.
projects.description: QLoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-1.5B on DialogSum, merged and quantized to 4-bit MLX, then shipped in a SwiftUI app that runs entirely on an iPhone 14 Pro. Apple draws its on-device LLM line at the A17 Pro with 8 GB of RAM; this runs below it on an A16 with 6 GB, at 880 MB on disk and 44.4 tokens per second.
projects.imageAlt: An A16 chip die with pins, glowing in violet, magenta and orange, with a chat bubble at its upper right
